_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Impact Estimate
summary: Specifies how to estimate the long-term affordability impact of a proposed range capability change to assist budgeting and resource reallocation decisions.
use_relationship:
The O&M Impact Estimate is used to assess the long-term affordability of new systems, and to assist in budgeting activities and reallocation of resources.  The O&M Impact Estimate quantifies the projected impact of a change in range capabilities, due to an addition or removal of equipment, alteration of operating hours, or any other proposed modification to the baseline range capabilities defined in the contract.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The O&M Impact Estimate shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The O&M Impact Estimate shall include the following:

children.title: Estimated annual labor hours for each position impacted
children.content: with separate estimates for preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and operation.

children.title: A brief justification for the estimates
A list of all references (i.e., tasking, e-mail, SRR minutes, Logistics Plan, etc.)
children.content: that were used to establish the scope of the change.

children.title: The estimate shall also include information
children.content: about multiple related systems when applicable.  For example, information in this section could provide an explanation for a proposed reduction in an existing capability to offset increased costs related to a new capability.
